about: Search engines a person can pick for the address bar of their own browser (the desktop app's Personal Browser). Words typed there that are not an address open a search on the engine they picked, in their own browser, as in any browser. These address-bar choices are for the person. Agents prefer exposed native search and remain subject to provider access rules, browser permissions and explicit workspace policies. `search` is an https link with exactly one {query}, where the typed words go, URL-encoded. `default` is the engine a person starts with. Keep the list short; add an engine only with a stable public search link.
